paper.title: Effect of single overload on fatigue crack growth in QSTE340TM steel and retardation model modification
paper.access_note: Publisher metadata and indexed primary-article method text were available; the full paywalled article and its dimensioned Fig. 1 were not present locally or available from the publisher text-mining endpoint without entitlement.

resolved_from_primary_article.crack_and_closure_measurement: compliance using a crack-mouth clip gauge
resolved_from_primary_article.experiment_scope: four load-ratio groups with constant-amplitude and single-overload records; overload and closure observations are paired views of those experiments

decisions.reason: The existing Arrhenius clock requires physical time and waveform, while the mechanics and stateful overload comparison require the actual geometry/load history and a material-specific local-stress/plasticity mapping.
